facts.text: The hotel is located in the heart of Auckland's CBD.
facts.excerpt: The luxury 5-star hotel is located in the heart of Auckland’s CBD

facts.text: The hotel is set within Windsor House, a building from the 1920s.
facts.excerpt: nestled within the storied Windsor House, a treasure of the roaring 1920s

facts.text: Jewel tones and a nod to the hotel's art deco origins run throughout the property.
facts.excerpt: with jewel tones and a nod to the art deco origins of the hotel throughout the property

facts.text: The hotel was previously known as Hotel Grand Windsor.
facts.excerpt: Fable Auckland - MGallery, previously known as Hotel Grand Windsor

facts.text: Rooms range from the Classic rooms to the Duchess and Windsor Suites.
facts.excerpt: from the Classic to the sumptuous ‘Duchess’ and ‘Windsor’ Suites

facts.text: The Windsor Suite has two bedrooms and a lounge with a balcony.
facts.excerpt: The Windsor Suite is the epitome of luxury featuring two spacious bedrooms and a generous lounge with balcony.

facts.text: The Duchess and Windsor Suites have a cocktail tray for making Fable cocktails in the room.
facts.excerpt: This suite also features an elegant cocktail tray, inviting you to craft our Fable cocktails in the comfort of your room.

facts.text: Rooms feature the Sofitel My Bed.
facts.excerpt: Sofitel My Bed

facts.text: Rooms have bath amenities from Marihi Aotearoa.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive amenities from Marihi Aotearoa

facts.text: Rooms have a T2 fine bone china tea set.
facts.excerpt: T2 fine bone china tea set

facts.text: The hot tub and sauna are booked by reservation only, and each session is private.
facts.excerpt: Our exclusive hot tub and sauna are available by reservation only

facts.text: Each hot tub and sauna session is reserved for a single party.
facts.excerpt: Each session is yours alone, offering an uninterrupted moment of indulgence.

facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: Fitness Centre 24/7

facts.text: In-room spa services are offered.
facts.excerpt: In-room spa services

facts.text: The hotel's art deco dining room offers a signature High Tea.
facts.excerpt: Perfect for any occasion, from a casual meal with delectable tapas to our signature High Tea.

facts.text: The restaurant is a charming Art Deco dining room off Queen Street.
facts.excerpt: Escape the hustle and bustle of Queen Street to unwind in our charming Art Deco dining room.

facts.text: The hotel holds Qualmark Gold sustainable hotel status.
facts.excerpt: Qualmark Gold sustainable hotel

facts.text: The hotel offers 24-hour room service.
facts.excerpt: 24-hour room service

facts.text: Valet parking is available for an extra fee.
facts.excerpt: We also offer valet parking for an extra fee

facts.text: The hotel's address is 58 Queen Street in the Auckland CBD.
facts.excerpt: 58 Queen Street

facts.text: The hotel restaurant is named The Windsor Room.
facts.excerpt: Introducing The Windsor Room, a polite nod to yesteryear’s English chophouses.

facts.text: The hotel restaurant is Cooke's Restaurant & Bar.
facts.excerpt: You can eat at Cooke's Restaurant & Bar, which serves dishes made from fresh local ingredients.

contradictions.note: p12 'Our Restaurant' section names The Windsor Room, while p12 FAQ and p4 high tea text name Cooke's Restaurant & Bar
